Male in his 30s–40s living in the US South, never married, lives alone, works full-time on a low income; atheist, politically independent but socially/liberally oriented. Married, retired White woman in her 50s–60s living in the Northeast; conservative/Republican, culturally Protestant but not very observant, financially comfortable and highly financially literate. White male (30–49) in the U.S. South, postgraduate-educated, single and living alone, employed full-time with mid income; politically moderate/independent and culturally Buddhist but non-practicing. Divorced white woman in her 50s–60s in the US West with an associate’s degree, unemployed, moderate income, atheist, and very liberal/Democrat. Widowed Hispanic man in his 30s–40s living in the US South; self-employed, high-income, high-school educated, weekly religious attendee, and politically conservative/Republican. Midwestern white male (30–49), divorced, agnostic, politically moderate/independent, highly educated and high-earning, working full-time in a household of four. Married Black man in his 50s–early 60s living in the Western US, highly educated and high-income, working full-time and supporting a large household; Protestant who attends church occasionally and frames identity around being a faithful, loving, and financially responsible family leader. Unemployed Hispanic woman in her 30s–40s in the Northeast, low income, high‑school educated, very liberal Democrat and nonreligious, living in a two‑person household. Midwest-based woman in her 50s–early 60s, college educated, Protestant and weekly churchgoer, politically independent but conservative, living in a two-person household with low income and currently unemployed. Young Hispanic Catholic woman in the U.S. South (18–29), moderate Democrat, part-time worker with an associate’s degree, living in a 4-person household and is a mother; values family/community and shows strong empathy, fairness, and generosity, tending to share evenly and to trust others while also being somewhat cautious about being treated unfairly. Married Hispanic Catholic woman (30–49) in the Western US with postgraduate education, a homemaker in a four-person household and moderate/independent politics.
